newsitem.title: CANADA: NBA BASKETBALL-GATLING, JACKSON TO NETS FOR BRADLEY, PACK IN 9-MAN DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-GATLING, JACKSON TO NETS FOR BRADLEY, PACK IN 9-MAN DEAL.

text.p: In one of the biggest trades in NBA history, the ever-changing Dallas Mavericks traded All-Star forward Chris Gatling, guards Jimmy Jackson and Sam Cassell, forward George McCloud and centre Eric Montross to the New Jersey Nets in a nine-player deal.
The Mavericks, under new basketball boss Don Nelson, received centre Shawn Bradley, guards Robert Pack and Khalid Reeves and forward Ed O'Bannon.
In a span of two months, they have traded Jackson, Jamal Mashburn and Jason Kidd, who were thought to be their nucleus into the next century.
